# Healing Therapy Center

> Mental health therapy center in Dearborn, Michigan offering compassionate, evidence-based care

## Services

- Individual Therapy: Personalized one-on-one counseling for anxiety, depression, trauma, and mental health support
- Couples Therapy: Marriage and relationship counseling to strengthen partnerships
- Family Therapy: Support for families navigating challenges together
- Group Therapy: Therapeutic support in a community setting
- Perinatal Therapy: Specialized care for pregnancy and postpartum mental health
- Psychological Testing: Comprehensive autism and ADHD evaluations for all ages
- Telehealth Therapy: Secure online therapy throughout Michigan

## Specialties

- ADHD Testing & Treatment (children and adults)
- Autism Evaluation & Support
- Trauma & PTSD Therapy (including EMDR)
- Anxiety & Depression Treatment
- Grief & Loss Counseling
- Teen Mental Health
- Federal Employee Mental Health (FEP Blue insurance accepted)

## Insurance

We accept most major insurance plans including:
- Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan
- FEP Blue (Federal Employee Program)
- Aetna
- Priority Health
- United Healthcare
- McLaren Health Plan
- HAP

## Approach

We believe healing is a process that takes time. Our person-first approach focuses on treating the individual, not just the diagnosis. We provide evidence-based therapy including:
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- Emotion Focused Therapy
- Trauma-Focused Therapy

## For Federal Employees

We specialize in serving federal employees with FEP Blue insurance coverage, including:
- USPS (United States Postal Service)
- CBP (Customs and Border Protection)
- FBI agents and staff
- VA employees
- Law enforcement and first responders
- All federal government workers

Confidential therapy with no employer notification.
